Caesar Cipher Tool

Caesar cipher with any shift 1–25, plus a brute-force cracker that shows all 25 possible shifts.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter text and pick a shift from 1 to 25.
  2. Choose Encode, Decode, or Crack (shows all 25 shifts).
  3. Press Run.
  4. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the Caesar cipher work?

Each letter shifts a fixed number of places (A→D with shift 3). Decoding shifts back by the same amount.

How does the crack mode work?

It tries all 25 shifts and lists every result, so you can spot the readable one.

Is it secure?

No — it is a classical teaching cipher and is trivially broken by brute force.
